population.productScope: Current word sense/POS and all15 grammar lessons; separate original target/grammar judgments and visible correction/explanation/question plus delivery/storage availability.
population.inputBoundary: All eligible English inputs accepted by existing max2000-character request schemas; unsupported/empty/overlong inputs are separately local contract controls,not silently excluded successful cases. Context note max500.
population.lengthAndLevel: Include very short complete commands,fragments,ordinary/long inputs near supported boundary; beginner/intermediate and more complex relations. Reviewer labels actual difficulty and length coverage before results; no CEFR certification inferred.
population.withinGrammarStrata: All15 lessons covered; lesson and difficulty minima must be frozen before authoring,not chosen after scores. No lesson-specific probabilistic guarantee from the pooled grammar strata.
population.samplingTarget: Only a preregistered synthetic challenge-family distribution. No access to actual learner inputs and no claim of service-wide/user-weighted error rate.
population.families: High-level error categories may repeat. A family is the syntactic frame, participant/temporal/quantity relation and contextual ambiguity operation. Mere changes of names, lemmas, number spelling, word order paraphrase or surface synonyms do not create a new family. Reviewer records the specific structural distinction.

harmDefinitions.falseTeachingRule: Qualified review confirms a factual false universal rule or unsupported confident teaching claim; observed count must0 as a separate content gate,not retrospectively added to historical critical flags.
harmDefinitions.anyDimensionFailure: Family/model fails when any planned visible output/repetition fails at least one of the five dimensions. Missing/rejected/uncertain is separately unmeasured or unavailable and prevents qualification,not a fabricated English mistake.
harmDefinitions.falseRejection: Required normal originals refused/rewritten without cause,visible over-abstention,and app rejection remain separate counts. Required normal false rejections0.
harmDefinitions.repeatFlip: Within same family/model at least one full pass and one full fail across preregistered repetitions. r2 defines a two-repeat event,not a lifetime repeat guarantee.
harmDefinitions.paired: For each family/model compare robust pass(all planned variants/repeats pass) baseline/candidate. Gain=baseline fail/candidate pass; loss=baseline pass/candidate fail; unknown either side is unmeasured,never gain/loss.

statisticalDesign.allocation: Equal Bonferroni alpha/114:6strata × (critical union1 +3models × (quality upper1 +flip upper1 +gain/loss four tails)). Correlation across models/endpoints is allowed for union bound; iid families within a stratum is still required for each binomial tail.
statisticalDesign.scopeOfCriticalUnion: Any of3models/variants/repetitions/4critical flags within each independent family. No3models×repetitions multiplier in sample units.
statisticalDesign.pairedEffect: [L(gain)-U(loss), U(gain)-L(loss)] from four prespecified exact binomial marginal tails per model/stratum. Conservative; gain/loss are paired mutually exclusive categories,not independent samples.
statisticalDesign.zeroEventPrecision: Sensitivity N assumes zero observed critical errors and complete iid families; it is not a power calculation or evidence that so many independent families are feasible.

mandatoryOtherMetrics.improvementScope: must preregister targeted family set and effect size separately; no improvement claim from noninferiority alone

statisticalDesign.earlyHarmStop: Stop and retain denominator/unknown costs,hold outcome. No reset/replacement/retry until new protocol and explicit approval.

sample.assumption: iid representative families within the stratum; all planned cells measured

proposedOtherCriteria.improvementScope: must preregister targeted family set and effect size separately; no improvement claim from noninferiority alone

sensitivityOptions.note: The n calculation addresses only zero-event critical precision. It does not prove feasible independent families,effect power,review capacity or affordable monetary cost. These are mandatory approval holds.

executionDesign.freshness: Development/calibration/pilot/confirmation families separate as T12/T13. Confirmation authored after candidate/policy freeze and pilot decisions,with author/reviewer exposure inventory and sealed alternatives. No actual new cases authored.
executionDesign.order: Before dispatch freeze deterministic seed and blocked randomized baseline/candidate/model order per family and repetition. Collect every planned cell; time/model alias changes remain diagnostics,not excuses to discard failures.
executionDesign.source: Use paired published-v147 baseline and current candidate full Worker fingerprints as prepared in T15; T16/T24 must seal actual bodies,build,input/rubric/environment/model/options/price/order hashes before any key access.
executionDesign.review: All valid visible outputs require review and resolution. Independent qualified English reviewer role/credential/exposure/conflict declaration required; current Codex is same-author engineer,no English-review credential claimed. Max valid outputs/reviews equals generation ceiling,adjudication decisions same ceiling.
executionDesign.production: Separate6generation calls,approved synthetic account/writes/budget,save/reload same UUID; never count as confirmatory language sample. No production call authorized.

monetaryBudget.formula: Sum per-slot ceiling(inputMax*inputPrice +outputMax*outputPrice) in integer microUSD with existing exact reservation rules,including failed/unknown and calibration; sum role maxima separately for pilot/confirmation/production. Human review costs separate. No price estimate or paid run is authorized by call counts.

challengeReview.risk: Literal or frame-reskinned examples inflate iid N
challengeReview.requiredResponse: Family structural review and preregistered sampling mechanism; if unavailable no numeric probabilistic claim.

challengeReview.risk: Averaging hides a weak lesson/model or rare harmful edit
challengeReview.requiredResponse: All6strata/3models,critical union and lesson coverage; no model averaging. No lesson risk claim without lesson-specific bounds/N.

challengeReview.risk: Shared judge/author bias and false gold
challengeReview.requiredResponse: Blind model/phase where feasible,calibration,new independent qualified English review; raw/review/adjudicated separate.
Predeclare114tails,one maximum look; no success peeking,alpha recycling,replacement or resend.

challengeReview.risk: Pair looks unchanged or precision inadequate
challengeReview.requiredResponse: Do not call noninferiority improvement. Prespecify targeted effect and power/precision; inconclusive stays held.
Do not fake independent families or reduce risk after scores. Prepare a new prospective design/method/claim scope with approval before collecting fresh data.

changeControl: After seeing outcomes,never weaken thresholds or edit original gold/scores. Retain failed/unknown evidence. New source/rubric/sample/alternative/criterion => new version,new runId,fresh unseen families and required new approval.
